scripts.compact: npm run compact:dice && npm run compact:turn
scripts.compact:fast: compact compile --skip-zk src/dice.compact src/managed/dice && compact compile --skip-zk src/turn.compact src/managed/turn
scripts.measure: scripts/measure-build.sh build/measure && node scripts/zkir-stats.mjs build/measure/dice-zk build/measure/turn-zk
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp -Rf src/managed dist/managed
scripts.ci: npm run compact && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
